bagPolicy.summary: Lucas Oil Live enforces a bag policy to enhance public safety. Approved bags include clear totes, plastic storage bags, and small clutch purses, while backpacks and other large bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clear Totes (Plastic, Vinyl, or PVC that do not exceed 12” x 6” x 12”)
Plastic Storage Bags (Clear, One (1) Gallon, Re-Sealable)
Small Clutch Purses (No larger than 12” x 6”)
bagPolicy.note: An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection at a gate designated for this purpose.

parking.note: Valet parking is available 24/7 for hotel guests at the Pool Tower entrance. Pricing varies based on membership status: Elite Club Passport Members park for free, Premier Members pay $5, Base Members pay $15, and non-carded patrons pay $20.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in WinStar Lucas Oil Live's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Union Mesa Restaurant & Cantina offers a refined take on traditional Tex-Mex cuisine with a curated menu featuring both classic and innovative dishes. Highlights include top shelf tequila selections, a unique margarita menu, and happy hour specials from 4:00 – 6:00 PM Monday – Wednesday.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by WinStar Lucas Oil Live, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in WinStar Lucas Oil Live's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at WinStar Lucas Oil Live. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at WinStar Lucas Oil Live. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
